<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>tryAddingPcLoadReferenceComment - trys to add a comment as to what is being referenced by a load instruction with the base register that is the Pc.</p>


<p>These can often be values in a literal pool near the Address of the instruction. The Address of the instruction and its immediate <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> are used as a possible literal pool entry. The SymbolLookUp call back will return the name of a symbol referenced by the literal pool's entry if the referenced address is that of a symbol. Or it will return a pointer to a literal 'C' string if the referenced address of the literal pool's entry is an address into a section with 'C' string literals.</p>


<p>Definition at line 878 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/arm/lib/target/arm/disassembler/armdisassembler-cpp">ARMDisassembler.cpp</a>.</p>

### tryAddingSymbolicOperand() {#aa5797af9ab82a541bb328fc944ce90ea}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">bool tryAddingSymbolicOperand (uint64_t Address, int32_t Value, bool isBranch, uint64_t InstSize, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcinst">MCInst</a> &amp; MI, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/aarch64/aarch64promoteconstant-cpp/#a90f8350fecae261c25be85d38b451bff">const</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcdisassembler">MCDisassembler</a> * Decoder)</td>

</td>
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsRight">
<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel static">static</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>tryAddingSymbolicOperand - trys to add a symbolic operand in place of the immediate <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> in the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcinst">MCInst</a>.</p>


<p>The immediate <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> has had any PC adjustment made by the caller. If the instruction is a branch instruction then isBranch is true, else false. If the getOpInfo() function was set as part of the setupForSymbolicDisassembly() call then that function is called to get any symbolic information at the Address for this instruction. If that returns non-zero then the symbolic information it returns is used to create an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcexpr">MCExpr</a> and that is added as an operand to the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcinst">MCInst</a>. If getOpInfo() returns zero and isBranch is true then a symbol look up for <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> is done and if a symbol is found an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcexpr">MCExpr</a> is created with that, else an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcexpr">MCExpr</a> with <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> is created. This function returns true if it adds an operand to the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcinst">MCInst</a> and false otherwise.</p>


<p>Definition at line 859 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/arm/lib/target/arm/disassembler/armdisassembler-cpp">ARMDisassembler.cpp</a>.</p>
